Finding — cmd/entire/cli/agent_group.go:152 (low severity):

`resolveNamedExternalAgent` promotes `discoverAndRegisterNamed`'s validation error into a hard command failure, so a mistyped name containing a path separator bypasses the friendly error path entirely. `entire agent add ./claude-code` (or a completion artifact like `bin/claude-code`) prints the raw:

    loading external agent "./claude-code": invalid external agent name "./claude-code": contains path separators

instead of the `Unknown agent …` message plus the available-agents listing and usage line that every other bad name gets. Same applies to `exec.ErrDot`, which `discoverAndRegisterNamed` also propagates as a non-`ErrNotFound` error when `.` is on `$PATH`.

Suggested fix: treat the path-separator case and `exec.ErrDot` as "no plugin by that name" — fall through to `printWrongAgentError` so the miss path stays uniform across `agent add` and `agent remove`. Keep genuine plugin *load* failures as hard errors (that distinction was deliberate in this PR).

Please add a test covering `entire agent add ./<name>` producing the friendly unknown-agent output. Follow the repo checklist before pushing: `mise run fmt && mise run lint && mise run test:ci` (note: use the mise-installed golangci-lint directly if a stale v1 shadows it).

When done, SendMessage back to "cli-d4" with what you changed and the commit/push result.
</cross-session-message>
